units.function: Embedded-PostgreSQL tests preventing copied development-worktree state from starting new or persisted queued Agent Runs, with an explicit activation cutoff for later human-initiated execution.
units.dependencyDirection: Heartbeat wake/resume/timer APIs consult runtime environment and instance experimental settings while writing wakeups, Runs, Issues and runtime state; a real process adapter is used for allowed execution.
units.keyDataModels: Worktree/instance environment flags, persisted worktree-execution activation cutoff, WakeupRequest skip reason, queued HeartbeatRun and Issue assignment.
units.lifecycle: Default-deny all scheduling in a worktree instance; leave copied queued Runs inert; suppress timers; when explicitly armed, reject pre-cutoff system wakes but permit a post-activation user wake; preserve ordinary live-plane behavior; restore mode remains unconditionally suppressed.
units.testAssessment: Five integration cases cover new wakes, copied queue replay, timer suppression, activation cutoff/user override, live-plane baseline and restore precedence. Missing are multiple instances, copied credentials/capabilities, cutoff clock skew, revoked activation, authorization of the arming user, audit receipt, queued records created between cutoff and activation, and deployment-profile compatibility.
units.designRationale: A copied database or development worktree must be inert by default so historical queued automation cannot execute against live tools; explicit activation establishes a temporal boundary for new human intent.
units.companyOsProblem: Self-hosted restore, cloning, backup verification, FDE staging and disaster recovery can duplicate executable state and credentials; Company OS must guarantee copied control planes are inert until deliberately activated.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE the inert-clone default and activation-epoch idea. Model it as a signed DeploymentActivation receipt through DeploymentControlPort, with instance identity, data/credential rebinding, responsible human, allowed execution profile and monotonic epoch; all queue and Connector leases must be scoped to that epoch. Do not depend on worktree environment variables.
units.responsibilityConflict: The persisted toggle/cutoff does not prove who authorized activation or that identities, secrets, data contracts and Connector endpoints were rebound. A generic user wake can execute after activation without an explicit action/approval contract.
